en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: The practical training is carried out in a selected horticultural or specialized company according to the focus of the study program (specialization) for which the professional practice is carried out. For the study program "Landscape Architecture" it is a condition to complete an practical training in any design office/studio/studio/company with the presence of an authorized architect (general authorization "A.0", authorization for Landscape Architecture "A.3", in exceptional cases authorization "Architecture" A.1) The conditions and requirements of the practical training are published on the website of the Faculty of Horticulture (STUDY → Student internships) - https://zf.mendelu.cz/student/praxe/
